name: SimpleMind
description_en:
SimpleMind is a product in the Mind mapping category. Its directory profile covers Visual Mind Map, Cross Platform Support, Search and Navigation Tools, Export to Document Formats, Offline Access, Collaboration Tools, Drag and Drop, Built-in Templates.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud) Mobile App (Android, iOS). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large). API support is listed as Available. Support channels are listed as Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Available Offers Free-forever and Custom plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: support shared work and communication between participants; move items directly through a visual interface. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.

资料所列运行方式为浏览器访问（云服务） 移动应用 (Android, iOS)。资料所列适用组织规模为小型、中型与大型组织。API 支持情况为提供。资料所列支持方式为在线支持。

第三方定价快照显示：提供免费试用 另有持续免费方案和定制方案。。这属于采集时的第三方参考，实际金额、计费周期、试用条件及地区可用性仍需核对官网。

根据这些功能，可重点评估以下任务：支持多人共同工作和沟通；通过可视化界面直接拖放内容项。这些是基于功能的使用场景建议，不能当作实际客户采用的证据。
